## Contract

Metres/axes/origin; bounds; intended camera and human reference; required node names;
sockets; pivots/limits; collisions/support surfaces; doors/ramps/lifts; live interfaces.

## Measured export

Triangles/vertices, meshes/materials/draws, texture dimensions/residency, GLB bytes,
LODs and transition behavior. Compare against applicable budgets/approved exceptions.
UV ownership, maps/colorspace, lighting/depth and animation contracts.

## Evidence and corrections

Named-node/bounds tests, sampled mechanism clearance, real game route and captures,
input coverage, before/after, failed findings and fixes. Studio-only work remains
studio-only. Model generation completion is not acceptance.

## Review and delivery

Independent rubric record, exact accepted export, known gaps and deployment status.
Preserve source and provenance; do not commit private recordings or provider tokens.
